description: Explore mode: AI-driven conversational interface for exploring requirements before entering the pipeline. Users chat with a thinking-partner agent to understand the codebase, clarify requirements, and crystallize findings into Issues.

tasks.title: Create explore database tables and repos
tasks.description: Create explore_sessions and explore_messages tables in SQLite. Implement ExploreSessionRepo and ExploreMessageRepo with CRUD operations, message listing by session, and crystallization support.
acceptanceCriteria: explore_sessions table created with id, project_id, issue_id, title, status, timestamps
explore_messages table created with id, session_id, role, content, tool_calls, created_at
ExploreSessionRepo supports create, get, list by project, delete, crystallize
ExploreMessageRepo supports add, get by session, cascade delete on session
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow existing repo patterns (issue-repo.ts, comment-repo.ts). Use better-sqlite3.

tasks.title: Implement read_file, glob, grep tools
tasks.description: Create read-file.ts, glob-tool.ts, and grep-tool.ts in tools/. Each tool uses Tool.define() pattern. read_file supports optional line range. glob uses node glob patterns. grep uses regex search. All tools restrict file access to the project directory via path.resolve + startsWith.
acceptanceCriteria: read_file tool reads file content with optional offset/limit
read_file rejects paths outside project directory
glob tool returns file paths matching pattern
grep tool returns matches with file paths and line numbers
All tools follow Tool.define() pattern from existing tools
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: These are reusable tools for future sub-agents too. Keep them generic (accept projectPath as context parameter).

tasks.title: Implement create_issue bridge tool
tasks.description: Create create-issue-tool.ts that creates a draft issue via IssueService and crystallizes the explore session. Accepts title, body, labels. Returns issue number on success.
acceptanceCriteria: create_issue tool creates a draft issue with provided title, body, labels
Tool updates session issue_id and status to crystallized
Tool returns the created issue number
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Needs IssueService and ExploreSessionRepo injected via context.

tasks.title: Implement explore agent
tasks.description: Create explore-agent.ts with thinking-partner system prompt. Wire up read_file, glob, grep, create_issue tools via ToolRegistry. Provide a runExploreAgent function that takes messages history and returns streaming response.
acceptanceCriteria: Explore agent has a thinking-partner system prompt distinct from MainAgent
Agent is equipped with read_file, glob, grep, create_issue tools only
Agent has no access to pipeline tools (spawn_coder, advance_stage, etc.)
runExploreAgent accepts message history for session recovery
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The system prompt should instruct the agent to be curious, read code to verify assumptions, use ASCII diagrams, and propose crystallization when requirements converge.

tasks.title: Implement ExploreService
tasks.description: Create explore-service.ts that encapsulates explore session business logic: create session, list sessions, get session with messages, delete session, add message, crystallize.
acceptanceCriteria: ExploreService.createSession creates a session with generated id and title
ExploreService.listSessions returns sessions ordered by updated_at desc
ExploreService.getSession returns session with all messages
ExploreService.deleteSession cascades delete messages
ExploreService.crystallize sets issue_id and status
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Pure service layer, no HTTP concerns.

tasks.title: Implement explore API routes
tasks.description: Create api/explore.ts with Hono routes: POST / (create session), GET / (list sessions), GET /:id (get session with messages), DELETE /:id (delete session), POST /:id/messages (send message with SSE streaming response). Register in server/index.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/explore creates session and returns session object
GET /api/explore?projectId=x lists sessions
GET /api/explore/:id returns session with messages
DELETE /api/explore/:id deletes session
POST /api/explore/:id/messages returns SSE stream with tool_call, chunk, done events
Routes registered in server/index.ts
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: The streaming endpoint should use streamText() directly (not runAgentLoop which consumes the entire stream). Forward tool_call and text chunk events via SSE as they arrive. Persist user and assistant messages to DB after stream completes.

tasks.title: Add explore_crystallized event to EventBus
tasks.description: Add explore_crystallized event to EventMap. Emit when explore session is crystallized. Add to SSE events list in events.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: EventMap includes explore_crystallized with sessionId, issueId, projectId
Event emitted when session crystallizes
SSE endpoint forwards explore_crystallized events
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Implement explore chat frontend
tasks.description: Create ExplorePage, ExploreChat, ExploreMessage, ExploreToolCall, ExploreInput components. Add /explore/:id route and /explore redirect. Add Explore button to Header. Implement SSE streaming hook for message sending. Render markdown in messages. Show tool calls as collapsible blocks.
acceptanceCriteria: /explore redirects to latest active session or creates new one
/explore/:id displays chat interface with message history
User and assistant messages are visually distinct
Tool calls shown as collapsible blocks with tool name, args, result
Agent responses stream in real-time
Input disabled during streaming
Markdown rendered in messages (code blocks, lists)
Explore button visible in Header
Build succeeds
tasks.notes: Use existing React + TanStack Query + Tailwind patterns. For markdown rendering, consider react-markdown or a lightweight alternative. For SSE streaming, create a custom hook similar to useSSE but for request-response pattern.

tasks.title: Navigate to created issue from explore
tasks.description: When agent creates an issue during exploration (done event with issueId), display a link/button to navigate to the issue detail page.
acceptanceCriteria: When done event contains issueId, display 'View Issue #N' link
Clicking link navigates to /issue/:number
Build succeeds
